runs.name: Global Water Resources, Inc.; Nasdaq GWRS, SEC CIK 0001434728; thirty-nine regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utility systems, principally metropolitan Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona, under the ACC, about 40,000 homes; rate-case settlement April 2026, GW-Palo Verde to refile in 2027; private placement of 1,129,944 shares 2026-08-20; rivals named in the 10-K, NWN Water and Algonquin file, EPCOR, Arizona Water, Central States and Ullico flagged as not SEC filers
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR (the price above the top of the range)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$7.74** (2026-10-28, aggregator, flagged) x **29,925,296 shares** (28,795,352 on the 10-Q cover of 2026-08-07, agreeing with issued less treasury, plus the 1,129,944-share private placement at $8.85 of 2026-08-20, 8-K 0001628280-26-058486) = cap **$231.6M**; sovereign **5.30%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). **Q1 IN** (all 2025 revenue of $55.8M ACC-regulated, one segment, 87.3% of connections in GW-Santa Cruz and GW-Palo Verde in one service area). **Q2 IN** on the CC&N exclusive right; regulated return carried to Q3; against: the ACC Staff recommended a revenue decrease of about $7.1M, the April 2026 settlement gives GW-Santa Cruz about $2.3M at 9.6% ROE and 55/45 and withdraws GW-Palo Verde's case to 2027 with a larger bill credit (8-K 0001628280-26-028741), two former utilities taken by condemnation, 81.9% of connections in one municipality. **Q3 weighs against** (about 4% after tax on capital employed against a 9.6% allowed return on equity; the $87M added since 2020 has not yet raised operating earnings). **Q4 weighs against, not a STOP** (readable accounts; an Adjusted EBITDA featured and used for bonuses; interest paid for 2022 stated as $11,355K in one 10-K and $1,450K in the next, recorded and not used). **Q5 integrity IN, ability against** (about $7.8M of Southwest Plant cost in rate base 2007 to 2024, found and reported to the ACC by the company in 2024, judged competence not honesty; the analyst writes that a reader who disagrees would close at Q5). **Q6 against** (dividends above earnings funded in part by six share sales in seven years; no buybacks, the test against the bottom of the range has nothing to test). Equity grew from $14.9M (2017) to $86.6M (2025) only through share sales; retained earnings near zero, dividends partly charged to paid-in capital; developer advances doubled to $155.4M; debt $131.8M plus $5.8M revolver; cash $1.5M at 2026-06-30. **Q7 OUT, on the floor, the price above the top of the range**: regulated-utility section applied, equity-only central; owner cash equity-only 2021 to 2025 after maintenance (depreciation as the guess) 6,465, 9,418, 9,706, 4,847, 1,496, mean **$6,386K**, falling 30.6% a year, carried as the bottom under (b); after all spending mean -$20,093K; the City of Buckeye growth premiums (to 2034, $2,326K a year) valued apart as a CONVENTION of the run; growth spending $18,366K year one to $682K year ten; utility debt credit $3,975K a year, cap 45% (the settlement's allowed debt share), not binding. Best case 3.8% on the market value; the full allowed return on an approximate rate base 4.9%. Value range equity-only, central, **-$0.42 to $4.57 a share**; all-equity -$4.63 to $2.84. **Fair price $1.07 equity-only, central**; all-equity -$2.51, not positive. Competitors (named in the 10-K, those that file): NWN Water operating margin 16.9% to 28.8% over 2023 to 2025 while GWRS fell from 23.2% to 12.8%; ACC Staff recommended increases for both filing rivals; Algonquin reports no separate water profit; EPCOR, Arizona Water, Central States, Ullico, Community Water and Voyager flagged as not SEC filers. Could not get: a maintenance and growth split of spending (the proxy calls $58.6M of 2025 spending non-growth, which would make depreciation a weak guess); NWN Water before 2023; Algonquin's water profit. Process departures declared by the analyst: the Q7 script and its output committed with Q1, before Q2 to Q6 were written; Q5 and Q6 in one commit. Framework gaps for the operator: specific (e) at a negative growth rate; the regulated-utility section for a utility that does not earn its allowed return (equity-only then above all-equity); a proxy-statement split as the filing that allows or forbids the maintenance guess; non-utility income ending inside ten years; developer-funded plant in net debt and owner cash; serial issuance as a candidate STOP. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 71 ids in the ledger, 26 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: the session's commit subjects about another company, memory index lines and a file count of `Test Runs/`; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: the Phoenix-area regulated water and wastewater utility, earning about 4% on capital against a 9.6% allowed return, owner cash after maintenance falling 30.6% a year, dividends above earnings funded by six share sales in seven years; equity-only value range -$0.42 to $4.57 against $7.74. Fair $1.07 equity-only, central; all-equity not positive; armed.
